title: Spider-Man: Web of Shadows
tagline: An original symbiote outbreak, not a movie.
summary: Web of Shadows tells an original story about a symbiote invasion of Manhattan. Shaba Games developed the PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360 versions. Other platforms had separate teams. The player’s choices push Peter toward or away from the black suit.
gameplay: Open Manhattan traversal with combo combat and a red-suit or black-suit stance. The story branches with those choices.
